reply.text: {"options":[{"name":"Smoky Chickpea Quinoa Power Bowl","why":"Hearty and fully plant-based, with a big protein base of chickpeas and quinoa.","cuisine":"Mediterranean","method":"oven","minutes":35,"servings":1,"mealType":"lunch","ingredients":[{"text":"60 g quinoa, dry","quantity":60,"unit":"g","food":"quinoa"},{"text":"160 g canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed","quantity":160,"unit":"g","food":"chickpeas"},{"text":"90 g baby spinach","quantity":90,"unit":"g","food":"baby spinach"},{"text":"100 g cucumber, diced","quantity":100,"unit":"g","food":"cucumber"},{"text":"100 g tomatoes, chopped","quantity":100,"unit":"g","food":"tomatoes"},{"text":"15 g olive oil","quantity":15,"unit":"g","food":"olive oil"},{"text":"1 tsp smoked paprika","quantity":2,"unit":"g","food":"smoked paprika"},{"text":"1 tsp cumin","quantity":2,"unit":"g","food":"cumin"},{"text":"15 g lemon juice","quantity":15,"unit":"g","food":"lemon juice"},{"text":"Salt to taste","quantity":null,"unit":"","food":"salt"}],"steps":["Heat the oven to 425°F. Pat the chickpeas dry and toss with half the olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin and a pinch of salt.","Roast the chickpeas on a sheet pan for 20 to 25 minutes, shaking the pan halfway, until crisp at the edges.","While they roast, rinse the quinoa and simmer it in twice its volume of water, covered, for about 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are fluffy.","Whisk the remaining oil with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.","Pile the spinach, cucumber and tomatoes in a bowl, add the warm quinoa and the crisp chickpeas, then drizzle with the lemon dressing."]},{"name":"Spiced Lentil Rice Bowl with Greens","why":"Budget-friendly and filling, built on lentils for a steady protein hit.","cuisine":"Indian","method":"pot","minutes":40,"servings":2,"mealType":"dinner","ingredients":[{"text":"140 g brown or green lentils, dry","quantity":140,"unit":"g","food":"brown or green lentils"},{"text":"100 g brown rice, dry","quantity":100,"unit":"g","food":"brown rice"},{"text":"120 g onion, diced","quantity":120,"unit":"g","food":"onion"},{"text":"3 cloves garlic, minced","quantity":9,"unit":"g","food":"garlic"},{"text":"10 g olive oil","quantity":10,"unit":"g","food":"olive oil"},{"text":"2 tsp curry powder","quantity":4,"unit":"g","food":"curry powder"},{"text":"400 g canned tomatoes","quantity":400,"unit":"g","food":"canned tomatoes"},{"text":"100 g kale, stems removed and chopped","quantity":100,"unit":"g","food":"kale"},{"text":"Salt and black pepper to taste","quantity":null,"unit":"","food":"salt"}],"steps":["Cook the rice in a covered pot with about twice its volume of water for 30 to 35 minutes until tender.","In a second pot, warm the oil and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and curry powder and stir for 30 seconds.","Add the rinsed lentils, the canned tomatoes and 350 g of water. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook 20 to 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.","Stir in the kale for the last 5 minutes until wilted.","Season with salt and pepper, then spoon the lentils over the rice in two bowls."]},{"name":"No-Cook White Bean Hummus Crunch Bowl","why":"No stove needed and ready in minutes, packed with plant protein.","cuisine":"Mediterranean","method":"no-cook","minutes":10,"servings":1,"mealType":"lunch","ingredients":[{"text":"150 g canned white beans, drained and rinsed","quantity":150,"unit":"g","food":"white beans"},{"text":"60 g hummus","quantity":60,"unit":"g","food":"hummus"},{"text":"80 g rocket","quantity":80,"unit":"g","food":"rocket"},{"text":"100 g cucumber, sliced","quantity":100,"unit":"g","food":"cucumber"},{"text":"100 g tomatoes, quartered","quantity":100,"unit":"g","food":"tomatoes"},{"text":"20 g almonds, roughly chopped","quantity":20,"unit":"g","food":"almonds"},{"text":"10 g olive oil","quantity":10,"unit":"g","food":"olive oil"},{"text":"15 g lemon juice","quantity":15,"unit":"g","food":"lemon juice"},{"text":"Salt and black pepper to taste","quantity":null,"unit":"","food":"salt"}],"steps":["Toss the white beans with the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper and let them sit for a few minutes.","Layer the rocket, cucumber and tomatoes in a bowl.","Spoon the dressed beans over the top and add a scoop of hummus on the side.","Scatter the chopped almonds over the bowl and eat right away."]}]}
